The Yard

A container kitchen with a garden for a dining room.

The kitchen

Red steel, open counter.

The cooks work out of a red and yellow shipping container. You can see the wok flame and the biriyani pot from your table, and you order right at the counter.

Open kitchenCounter ordering

The seating

Long benches, gravel underfoot.

Wooden trestle tables seat the whole family, with smaller tables under the trees for two. Steel water jugs come to every table.

Group tablesCovered and open-sky

The light

Strung bulbs and glowing trees.

After sunset the yard runs on warm string lights, lit tree trunks and light poles along the road. It is the reason most people come at night.

Best after 7 pmPhoto-friendly

House signature

Biriyani Chaya

The order regulars swear by: a plate of biriyani with a hot glass of chaya on the side. It is the Red Tea combo, and it is what the name is about.

Nights at Red Tea

Come for dinner, stay for the evening.
